title: imcat
description: Assembles a set of images into an image matrix (IM) montage of NX by NY images.

scale_image.description: Multiply each image IM(i,j) in output image matrix IM by the color or intensity of the pixel (i,j) in SCALE_IMG.
scale_image.title: Scale image

scale_pixels.description: Multiply each pixel (i,j) in output image by the color or intensity of the pixel (i,j) in SCALE_IMG. SCALE_IMG is automatically resized to the resolution of the output image.
scale_pixels.title: Scale pixels

scale_intensity.description: Instead of multiplying by the color of pixel (i,j), use its intensity (average color).
scale_intensity.title: Scale intensity flag

gscale.description: Apply FAC in addition to scaling of -scale_* options.
gscale.title: Global scale factor

rgb_out.description: Force output to be in RGB, even if input is bytes. This option is turned on automatically in certain cases.
rgb_out.title: RGB output flag

res_in.description: Set resolution of all input images to RX by RY pixels. Default is to make all input have the same resolution as the first image.
res_in.title: Input resolution

respad_in.description: Like -res_in, but resample to the max while respecting the aspect ratio, and then pad to achieve desired pixel count.
respad_in.title: Input resolution with padding

pad_val.description: Set the padding value, should it be needed by -respad_in to VAL. VAL is typecast to byte, default is 0, max is 255.
pad_val.title: Padding value

crop.description: Crop images by L (Left), R (Right), T (Top), B (Bottom) pixels. Cutting is performed after any resolution change, if any, is to be done.
crop.title: Crop parameters

autocrop_ctol.description: A line is eliminated if none of its R G B values differ by more than CTOL% from those of the corner pixel.
autocrop_ctol.title: Autocrop color tolerance

autocrop_atol.description: A line is eliminated if none of its R G B values differ by more than ATOL% from those of line average.
autocrop_atol.title: Autocrop average tolerance

autocrop.description: This option is the same as using both of -autocrop_atol 20 and -autocrop_ctol 20
autocrop.title: Autocrop flag

zero_wrap.description: If number of images is not enough to fill matrix solid black images are used.
zero_wrap.title: Zero wrap flag

white_wrap.description: If number of images is not enough to fill matrix solid white images are used.
white_wrap.title: White wrap flag

gray_wrap.description: If number of images is not enough to fill matrix, solid gray images are used. GRAY must be between 0 and 1.0.
gray_wrap.title: Gray wrap value

image_wrap.description: If number of images is not enough to fill matrix, images on command line are reused (default).
image_wrap.title: Image wrap flag

rand_wrap.description: When reusing images to fill matrix, randomize the order in refill section only.
rand_wrap.title: Random wrap flag

prefix.description: Prefix the output files with string 'ppp'.
prefix.title: Prefix

matrix.description: Specify number of images in each row and column of IM at the same time.
matrix.title: Matrix dimensions

nx.description: Number of images in each row.
nx.title: Number of rows

ny.description: Number of images in each column.
ny.title: Number of columns

matrix_from_scale.description: Set NX and NY to be the same as the SCALE_IMG's dimensions. (needs -scale_image)
matrix_from_scale.title: Matrix from scale flag

gap.description: Put a line G pixels wide between images.
gap.title: Gap width

gap_col.description: Set color of line to R G B values. Values range between 0 and 255.
gap_col.title: Gap color
